newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Messina issues further cautionary.
newsitem.headline: Messina issues further cautionary.

text.p: Messina Investments Ltd (Minvest) announced on Tuesday that it had signed an agreement with Barbados-based Becksham Corp which intended to offer to buy Minvest's entire share capital for 500 cents a share.
It said the proposed offer would be made prior to January 31 1997 and was conditional on Becksham raising suffficient funds to finance the offer.
The offer was also conditional upon Becksham acquiring the whole issued share capital of Minvest.
Minvest said that should it sell its shareholding in Van Oudtshoornstroom Coal (Pty) Ltd or should that company sell its coal rights, Minvest could distribute the difference as a cash dividend.
The company advised shareholders to exercise caution in their sharedealings pending the publication of further announcements.
